checkedAlternates.risk: A Try is a scoring play like a Conversion.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A Try is grounded across the try line for 5 points (group-1), whereas Conversions and Penalty Goals are kicks through the posts (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Rucks and Scrums both involve packs binding together.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A Scrum is a formal set-piece restart after a stoppage (group-3), whereas a Ruck forms dynamically in open play (group-4).
